connector.name: StarReview
connector.registryDescription: Drafts Google & TripAdvisor review replies; agents can never post themselves. Free rate check.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.starreview.ch over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the fabsbags account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Required at this endpoint. Connect via OAuth (recommended, plug-and-play; discovered from the endpoint's .well-known/oauth-protected-resource) OR send a per-business bearer token (format: sragt_...) as: Authorization: Bearer sragt_... The free discovery tools (get_service_info, search_business, check_response_rate) need no credential but live at a separate URL: POST https://mcp.starreview.ch/public
